text:
alex_ae: Hey team — POC with Ellie's account hitting blockers. Customer sees `model not available in region` and sometimes 429s. Need quick triage for tomorrow demo :grimacing:
ellie_cust: repro steps — using `POST /v1/generate` against eu-west-1, model `redwood-large-2024` and get 404 + a deprecation header sometimes. Also asking about pinning to a version and pricing for dedicated pool during trial.
jamie_se: Got it. Can you paste the full curl and headers? 404 + deprecation header usually means the model variant was removed in that region or the alias points to a deprecated backend.
ellie_cust: curl snippet:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-large-2024","input":"hello"}'
```
Response: `{"error":"model not available in region","code":404,"meta":"x-model-deprecated: true"}`
jamie_se: Thanks. Looks like the instance-route for `redwood-large-2024` is being migrated out of eu-west-1 this week. Two short-term options: pin to `redwood-large-2024@v2024-11-02` if that's in the customer's allowed model list, or route requests to `redwood-large-2025` (newer) with a compatibility shim. Pinning avoids behavioral deltas but needs version present in region.
priya_sre: Checking infra — eu-west-1 capacity is tight this sprint. We have a handful of reserved slots but not for new free trial tenants. If the customer needs low-latency eu-west, we can offer a short Dedicated trial (1-week) with reserved pool at a discounted pilot rate.
tomas_saleseng: Pricing note for AE — pilot dedicated pool promo: 2 GPU reserved for 1 week at 40% off. If they commit to 3 months we can apply enterprise credits. I'll draft offer once we confirm technical viability.
ellie_cust: Also seeing intermittent 429s even when model returns 404 earlier in flow. They worry it's rate limiting from a regional front proxy.
jamie_se: 429s likely from a fallback route hitting a throttled cluster. Can you enable `X-Debug-Route: true` and resend a failing request so we can get the routing headers? Also include `X-Request-Id` value so we can trace.
ellie_cust: Ok re-run with headers, will paste trace in a sec.
deploy-bot: deploy to region eu-west-1 completed: roll 0 -> 1, affected models: redwood-large-2025, redwood-small-quant.
priya_sre: Noted — rollout may explain 404 spikes. We can temporarily add an automatic fallback to `redwood-small-quant` in the routing policy for this account to avoid demo downtime; quality drop but latency and availability improve.
jamie_se: Quick workaround steps: 1) ask customer to set `model: redwood-small-quant` in their POC to confirm flow works; 2) we attempt to pin `redwood-large-2024@v2024-11-02` to their tenant in eu-west-1 (requires infra approval); 3) if pin fails, offer dedicated trial.
ellie_cust: Can you confirm whether pinning requires extra security review? Customer's legal/security team asked about model residency and KMS keys.
security-bot: Security checklist — pinning model versions in-region requires an entry in our KMS allowlist for customer-managed keys if they request private key usage. Standard hosted with our KMS is fine. Also need to confirm retention settings for logs (they asked 90 days).
alex_ae: Action items: Jamie — try pin in eu-west for ellie's tenant and report back. Priya — confirm capacity & whether we can grant a 1-week reserved trial. Tomas — prepare pricing term for 1-week pilot and 3-month commit. Ellie — please paste the X-Debug-Route response + X-Request-Id here. We'll aim to have a patched flow by tomorrow 9am CET. :crossed_fingers:
jamie_se: On it, will start pin request now and attach infra ticket number when created.
priya_sre: Opening capacity ticket and tagging oncall.
ellie_cust: Posting debug headers: `X-Request-Id: rq_01F7Z4C3`, `X-Routed-From: eu-west-1-proxy-07`, `X-Fallback-Model: redwood-large-2025` — here's the full trace log pasted to support email.
jamie_se: Perfect, that's the trace we needed. If infra approves pining, we'll keep the customer on v2024-11-02 for the demo and then migrate them to redwood-large-2025 with a changelog and QA.
alex_ae: Great. If pin denied, Priya you'll surface dedicated trial quote so we can close the loop. Thanks everyone, will loop Ellie in the sales thread with proposed next steps. :thumbsup:
